blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__account_enhanced
      description: Enhanced Salesforce account records with derived size, region, age, maturity, completeness, and high-value flags; filtered to non-deleted accounts
      grain: One row per account_id (non-deleted)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__account and keep only rows where is_deleted is false. - Pass through source fields and rename: type → account_type; industry → industry_normalized. - Derive account_size_segment from annual_revenue: - >= 10,000,000 → "Enterprise"; >= 1,000,000 → "Mid-Market"; >= 100,000 → "SMB"; > 0 → "Small"; otherwise "Unknown" (includes NULL and <= 0). - Derive geographic_region from billing_country after uppercasing for comparison: - {"UNITED STATES","US","USA","CANADA"} → "North America"; {"UNITED KINGDOM","UK","GERMANY","FRANCE"} → "Europe"; all others (including NULL) → "Other". - Derive account_age_days: - If last_activity_date is not NULL, compute the number of days from last_activity_date (date only) to today; else NULL. Negative values are possible if last_activity_date is in the future. - Derive account_maturity_stage: - If last_activity_date is NULL → "Unknown"; else if account_age_days < 365 → "Active"; else → "Mature". - Derive data_completeness_score: - Add 50 points if website is present and not empty after trimming whitespace; add 50 points if annual_revenue is present and > 0; possible values are 0, 50, or 100. - Derive is_high_value_account: - TRUE if annual_revenue >= 5,000,000; otherwise FALSE (NULL treated as FALSE). - Include is_deleted from the filtered set; it will always be FALSE.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key from source; exactly one output row per account_id in non-deleted accounts
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name passed through from source unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number passed through from source unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct rename of source column type; values passed through unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: account_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account source passed through from source unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: industry_normalized
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct rename of source column industry; no additional normalization; NULLs preserved
      - name: account_size_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Revenue-based segment: >=10,000,000 Enterprise; >=1,000,000 Mid-Market; >=100,000 SMB; >0 Small; else Unknown; computed from annual_revenue with NULL and <=0 → Unknown'
      - name: geographic_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Region based on uppercased billing_country: North America if in {UNITED STATES, US, USA, CANADA}; Europe if in {UNITED KINGDOM, UK, GERMANY, FRANCE}; else Other; NULL → Other'
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from last_activity_date (date) to today; NULL if last_activity_date is NULL; negative values possible if last_activity_date is in the future
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unknown if last_activity_date is NULL; else Active if account_age_days < 365; else Mature
      - name: data_completeness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '0, 50, or 100: +50 if website is present and not empty after trimming; +50 if annual_revenue is present and > 0; never NULL'
      - name: is_high_value_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if annual_revenue >= 5,000,000; else FALSE; NULL annual_revenue treated as FALSE; never NULL
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Annual revenue passed through from source; scale 2; NULLs and negatives preserved
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count passed through from source unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_street
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing street from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing city from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing state from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_postal_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing postal code from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: billing_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing country from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved (classification uses uppercase internally)
      - name: website
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Website passed through unchanged; completeness scoring treats it as non-empty only if present and not just whitespace; NULLs preserved
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner ID passed through from source unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: last_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Last activity date passed through from source; used in age/maturity derivations; NULLs preserved
      - name: last_referenced_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last referenced timestamp from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: last_viewed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last viewed timestamp from source; unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: is_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Deletion flag from source; always FALSE in output due to pre-filter; never NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__activity_summary
      description: Account-level summary from Salesforce tasks and events for active accounts; counts are across all filtered activities (no time windows), and several fields are fixed placeholders per current SQL.
      grain: One row per active (is_deleted=false) account_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__task
      - staging.stg_salesforce__event
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account
      business_logic: '- Define the output account set from staging.stg_salesforce__account where is_deleted=false; return one row per account_id. - Build task_activities from staging.stg_salesforce__task: - Keep rows where is_deleted=false, what_id is not null, and what_id has length 18 characters. - Set account_id from what_id, carry owner_id, set created_date from Task.created_date, and label activity_type as "Task". - Build event_activities from staging.stg_salesforce__event: - Keep rows where is_deleted=false, what_id is not null, and what_id has length 18 characters. - Set account_id from what_id, carry owner_id, set created_date from Event.activity_date, and label activity_type as "Event". - Union all task_activities and event_activities; duplicates are retained. - Aggregate per account_id (no date windowing is applied despite column names): - total_activities_30d, total_activities_90d, total_activities_365d: count of all unioned activity rows; these three values are identical. - completed_tasks_30d, open_tasks_30d, total_events_30d: constant 0. - avg_meeting_duration_minutes: constant 0.0. - unique_activity_owners: number of distinct owner_id values, ignoring nulls. - activity_frequency_score: constant "Medium". - last_activity_date: the latest activity date (date component of created_date). - days_since_last_activity: whole days between last_activity_date and the current date; null if no activity. - engagement_temperature: constant "Warm". - activity_trend_30d: constant "Stable". - is_declining_engagement: constant false. - most_active_user_id: constant 1. - activity_diversity_score: constant 50. - Left join these metrics to the active account set on account_id, and join staging.stg_salesforce__account again to pull account_name. - Apply defaults when no metrics exist for an account (i.e., no activities): - account_name: "Unknown" if null. - total counts and scores: 0 (use 0.0 for avg_meeting_duration_minutes). - activity_frequency_score: "Minimal". - engagement_temperature: "Cold". - activity_trend_30d: "New". - is_declining_engagement: false. - most_active_user_id, last_activity_date, and days_since_last_activity remain null.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce account identifier for active accounts; one output row per account_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from staging.stg_salesforce__account; defaults to 'Unknown' when null.
      - name: total_activities_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of all filtered task and event activities for the account (no 30-day window); defaults to 0.
      - name: total_activities_90d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of all filtered activities (no 90-day window); equals total_activities_30d; defaults to 0.
      - name: total_activities_365d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of all filtered activities (no 365-day window); equals total_activities_30d; defaults to 0.
      - name: completed_tasks_30d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0 per current SQL; defaults to 0.
      - name: open_tasks_30d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0 per current SQL; defaults to 0.
      - name: total_events_30d
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0 per current SQL; defaults to 0.
      - name: avg_meeting_duration_minutes
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant 0.0 minutes; defaults to 0.0.
      - name: unique_activity_owners
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of owner_id across filtered activities; null owners ignored; defaults to 0.
      - name: activity_frequency_score
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical score: ''Medium'' when any activity exists, else ''Minimal''.'
      - name: last_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest activity date for the account (date component); null when no activity.
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between last_activity_date and current date; null when last_activity_date is null.
      - name: engagement_temperature
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical status: ''Warm'' when any activity exists, else ''Cold''.'
      - name: activity_trend_30d
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical trend: ''Stable'' when any activity exists, else ''New''.'
      - name: is_declining_engagement
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Always false per current SQL; defaults to false.
      - name: most_active_user_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 1 when any activity exists; null when no activity.
      - name: activity_diversity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 50 when any activity exists; defaults to 0.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__date_spine
      description: Date spine from the earliest opportunity created_date to current_date (inclusive) with standard calendar attributes.
      grain: One row per calendar date from earliest opportunity created_date through current_date (inclusive)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity (created_date)
      business_logic: '- Determine the start date as the earliest created_date from staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity, using only the calendar date portion. - Set the end date to the current calendar date at query execution time. - If no start date exists (no source rows), produce no rows. - Generate one row per day from the start date to the end date, inclusive, stepping by one day. - For each date_day, derive: - year: calendar year. - quarter: calendar quarter (1–4). - month: calendar month number (1–12). - week: ISO week number (1–53); the ISO week-year may differ from the calendar year. - day_of_week: day of week number where 0=Sunday, …, 6=Saturday. - day_of_year: day number within the year (1–366). - Order the output ascending by date_day.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date generated for each day from the start date to current_date (inclusive); unique, not null, and sorted ascending in the output.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year of date_day; not null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter of date_day (1–4); not null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number of date_day (1–12); not null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: ISO week number of date_day (1–53); ISO week-year may differ from the calendar year; not null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_of_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day of week for date_day where 0=Sunday..6=Saturday; not null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_of_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day number within the year for date_day (1–366); not null.
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel
      description: Lead funnel metrics for non-deleted Salesforce leads with age, quality, source/category, conversion timing/completeness, and temperature
      grain: One row per lead_id (non-deleted leads)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      business_logic: '1) Start from staging.stg_salesforce__lead and include only leads where is_deleted = false. 2) Compute lead_name by joining first_name and last_name with a single space; treat NULLs as empty strings; remove leading/trailing spaces from the result. 3) Compute lead_age_days: - If is_converted is true: number of days between the date part of created_date and the date part of converted_date. - Else: number of days between the date part of created_date and the current calendar date at query time. - Result is NULL if created_date is NULL or (in the converted branch) converted_date is NULL. 4) Compute lead_quality_score (integer 10–100) as the sum of: - +20 if email is present and contains both "@" and "."; else +0. - +15 if phone is present and not empty after removing surrounding spaces; else +0. - +5 if mobile_phone is present and not empty after removing surrounding spaces; else +0. - +10 if industry is present and not empty after removing surrounding spaces; else +0. - +15 if annual_revenue is present and greater than 0; else +0. - +10 if number_of_employees is present and greater than 0; else +0. - +20 if lead_source (case-insensitive) is one of {referral, website, web, partner referral, word of mouth}; else +10. - +5 if company is present and not empty after removing surrounding spaces and, case-insensitively, not in {test, example, sample, demo, unknown, n/a, none}; else +0. 5) Map lead_source_category (case-insensitive): - Digital: {web, website, online, social media, email, google ads, linkedin} - Referral: {referral, partner referral, word of mouth, employee referral} - Marketing: {trade show, event, conference, purchased list, advertising} - Direct: {phone inquiry, direct mail, cold call} - Other: any other value, including NULL. 6) Compute conversion_time_days: if is_converted is true and converted_date is present, number of days between the date parts of created_date and converted_date; otherwise NULL. 7) Compute has_complete_conversion: true only if is_converted is true and converted_account_id, converted_contact_id, and converted_opportunity_id are all present; else false. 8) Compute lead_temperature from lead_quality_score: ≥80 → Hot; blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__opportunity_aggregation_by_owner
      description: Owner-level rollup of opportunity outcomes (won, lost, pipeline) with counts, amounts, timing averages, and manager resolution prioritized by pipeline then won then lost.
      grain: One row per salesforce_user.user_id (owner)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user_role
      business_logic: '1) Build an enhanced opportunity view by joining: - Opportunity to Account on account_id. - Opportunity.owner_id to User (owner). - Owner.manager_id to User (manager). - Owner.user_role_id to User Role. Derive status: - Won when is_won is true. - Lost when is_won is false and is_closed is true. - Pipeline when is_closed is false and forecast_category is one of pipeline, forecast, or bestcase (case-insensitive). Derive helper fields: - created_amount_this_month/quarter: amount when the opportunity was created in the period, otherwise 0. - created_count_this_month/quarter: 1 when created in the period, otherwise 0. - closed_amount_this_month/quarter: amount when closed in the period, otherwise 0. - closed_count_this_month/quarter: 1 when closed in the period, otherwise 0. Notes: If amount is null when a condition is true, the derived amount is null; sums and averages ignore nulls; zeros contribute as zero. 2) Won aggregation (booking_by_owner): keep rows with status = Won and aggregate by owner and their manager. - bookings_amount_closed_this_month/quarter: sum of the respective closed amounts, rounded to the nearest whole number. - total_number_bookings: number of Won opportunities. - total_bookings_amount: sum of amount, rounded to the nearest whole number. - bookings_count_closed_this_month/quarter: sum of the 1/0 closed flags (0 if group exists but no flags). - avg_bookings_amount: average amount, rounded to the nearest whole number. - largest_booking: maximum amount. - avg_days_to_close: average days_to_close. Duplicates are preserved; ordering is irrelevant. 3) Lost aggregation (lost_by_owner): keep rows with status = Lost and aggregate by owner and their manager. - lost_amount_this_month/quarter: sum of the respective closed amounts, rounded to the nearest whole number. - total_number_lost: number of Lost opportunities. - total_lost_amount: sum of amount, rounded to the nearest whole number. - lost_count_this_month/quarter: sum of the 1/0 closed flags (0 if group exists but no flags). 4) Pipeline aggregation (pipeline_by_owner): keep rows with status = Pipeline and aggregate by owner and their manager. - pipeline_created_amount_this_month/quarter: sum of the respective created amounts, rounded to the nearest whole number. - pipeline_created_forecast_amount_this_month/quarter: sum of created amount multiplied by probability, rounded to the nearest whole number. - pipeline_count_created_this_month/quarter: sum of the 1/0 created flags (0 if group exists but no flags). - total_number_pipeline: number of Pipeline opportunities. - total_pipeline_amount: sum of amount, rounded to the nearest whole number. - total_pipeline_forecast_amount: sum of amount multiplied by probability, rounded to the nearest whole number. - avg_pipeline_opp_amount: average amount, rounded to the nearest whole number. - largest_deal_in_pipeline: maximum amount. - avg_days_open: average days_since_created. Products with null operands are null and are ignored by sums/averages. 5) Final output: start from all users and left join each aggregation on owner_id = user_id. manager_id is chosen by precedence: pipeline manager, else won manager, else lost manager. If an owner has no rows in all three aggregations, manager_id and all aggregate columns are null. One row per owner.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__opportunity_pipeline
      description: Opportunity pipeline with account enrichment, stage scoring, size categorization, weighted value, and date-based risk/status metrics
      grain: One row per opportunity_id; may duplicate if multiple account_enhanced matches per account_id; only non-deleted opportunities
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity filtered to is_deleted = false. - Left join intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced on account_id; if multiple matches exist, rows duplicate; if no match, account fields are NULL. - Pass through opportunity fields: opportunity_id, opportunity_name, account_id, stage_name, amount, expected_revenue, probability, forecast_category, lead_source, campaign_id, fiscal_quarter, fiscal_year, is_closed, is_won, close_date, owner_id, created_date, is_deleted. - Bring account fields: account_name, account_size_segment, is_high_value_account, geographic_region, industry_normalized. - stage_progression_score: exact string mapping on stage_name → Prospecting:10; Qualification:20; Needs Analysis:30; Value Proposition:40; Proposal/Price Quote:70; Closed Won:100; Closed Lost:0; all others:50. - deal_size_category: by amount with inclusive thresholds and strict positivity → ≥100000:Large; ≥25000:Medium; ≥5000:Small; >0:Micro; else:Unknown. NULL, 0, or negative amounts map to Unknown. - weighted_pipeline_value: treat NULL amount and probability as 0; compute (amount × probability) ÷ 100; floating-point result; no rounding. - win_probability_confidence: from probability (percent) → ≥75:High Confidence; ≥50:Medium Confidence; ≥25:Low Confidence; else:Very Low. NULL probability falls to Very Low. - opportunity_age_days: number of days from the date part of created_date to today; time-varying; NULL if created_date is NULL; can be negative if created_date is in the future. - deal_velocity_risk: based on opportunity_age_days → >180:High Risk; >90:Medium Risk; else:Low Risk. If age is NULL (created_date missing), result is Low Risk. - close_date_status: if close_date is before today:Overdue; if on or before 90 days from today:Current Quarter; else:On Track. NULL close_date is treated as On Track. - days_to_close: number of days from today to the date part of close_date; NULL if close_date is NULL; negative if in the past, 0 if today. - is_strategic_deal: true if amount ≥ 500000 or account_size_segment equals ''Enterprise''; else false. NULL inputs evaluate to false. - is_deleted output remains false due to the initial filter.'
      columns:
      - name: opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique opportunity identifier; duplicates may occur if the account join returns multiple matches
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: opportunity_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity name from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID owning the opportunity from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from int_salesforce__account_enhanced via left join; NULL if no account match
      - name: account_size_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account size segment from int_salesforce__account_enhanced; used by is_strategic_deal (exact string match)
      - name: is_high_value_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: High-value account flag from int_salesforce__account_enhanced; may be NULL if no account match
      - name: geographic_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Geographic region from int_salesforce__account_enhanced; NULL if no account match
      - name: industry_normalized
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Normalized industry from int_salesforce__account_enhanced; NULL if no account match
      - name: stage_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales stage name from stg_salesforce__opportunity; exact string used for stage scoring
      - name: stage_progression_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Stage score mapped from stage_name: Prospecting=10, Qualification=20, Needs Analysis=30, Value Proposition=40, Proposal/Price Quote=70, Closed Won=100, Closed Lost=0, else=50'
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Opportunity amount; used for size categorization, weighted value, and strategic flag; may be NULL
      - name: deal_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Deal size by amount: ≥100000 Large; ≥25000 Medium; ≥5000 Small; >0 Micro; else Unknown (NULL/0/negative → Unknown)'
      - name: expected_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Expected revenue from stg_salesforce__opportunity; passthrough
      - name: probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(5,2)
        description: Win probability percent from stg_salesforce__opportunity; NULL treated as 0 for weighting and as Very Low for confidence
      - name: weighted_pipeline_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Computed as (amount × probability) ÷ 100 with NULLs treated as 0; floating-point result with no rounding
      - name: win_probability_confidence
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Confidence tier from probability: ≥75 High, ≥50 Medium, ≥25 Low, else Very Low; NULL probability → Very Low'
      - name: opportunity_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from created_date (date part) to today; time-varying; NULL if created_date is NULL; can be negative if created_date is in the future
      - name: deal_velocity_risk
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk tier from opportunity_age_days: >180 High, >90 Medium, else Low; NULL age (missing created_date) → Low'
      - name: close_date_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Status vs today: before today Overdue; on or before 90 days from today Current Quarter; else On Track; NULL close_date → On Track'
      - name: days_to_close
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from today to close_date (date part); NULL if close_date is NULL; negative if in the past
      - name: is_strategic_deal
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if amount ≥ 500000 or account_size_segment is 'Enterprise'; else false; NULL inputs evaluate to false
      - name: forecast_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Forecast category from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: lead_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead source from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: fiscal_quarter
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fiscal quarter number from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: fiscal_year
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fiscal year from stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - name: is_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Closed flag from stg_salesforce__opportunity; passthrough
      - name: is_won
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Won flag from stg_salesforce__opportunity; passthrough
      - name: close_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Close date from stg_salesforce__opportunity; used for status and days_to_close; may be NULL
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user ID from stg_salesforce__opportunity

alternatives.expression_sql: CAST(CASE op.stage_name WHEN 'Prospecting' THEN 10 WHEN 'Qualification' THEN 20 WHEN 'Needs Analysis' THEN 30 WHEN 'Value Proposition' THEN 40 WHEN 'Proposal/Price Quote' THEN 70 WHEN 'Closed Won' THEN 100 WHEN 'Closed Lost' THEN 0 ELSE 50 END AS INT)
CASE WHEN op.amount >= 100000 THEN 'Large' WHEN op.amount >= 25000 THEN 'Medium' WHEN op.amount >= 5000 THEN 'Small' WHEN op.amount > 0 THEN 'Micro' ELSE 'Unknown' END
CAST(((CAST(COALESCE(op.amount, 0) AS DOUBLE) * CAST(COALESCE(op.probability, 0) AS DOUBLE)) / 100.0) AS DOUBLE)
CASE WHEN op.probability >= 75 THEN 'High Confidence' WHEN op.probability >= 50 THEN 'Medium Confidence' WHEN op.probability >= 25 THEN 'Low Confidence' ELSE 'Very Low' END
CASE WHEN NOT op.created_date IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(op.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) END

CASE WHEN NOT op.created_date IS NULL AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(op.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) > 180 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN NOT op.created_date IS NULL AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(op.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) > 90 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END
CASE WHEN op.close_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Overdue' WHEN op.close_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 'Current Quarter' ELSE 'On Track' END
CASE WHEN NOT op.close_date IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CURRENT_DATE, op.close_date) END

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity filtered to is_deleted = false. - Left join intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced on account_id; if multiple matches exist, rows duplicate; if no match, account fields are NULL. - Pass through opportunity fields: opportunity_id, opportunity_name, account_id, stage_name, amount, expected_revenue, probability, forecast_category, lead_source, campaign_id, fiscal_quarter, fiscal_year, is_closed, is_won, close_date, owner_id, created_date, is_deleted. - Bring account fields: account_name, account_size_segment, is_high_value_account, geographic_region, industry_normalized. - stage_progression_score: exact string mapping on stage_name → Prospecting:10; Qualification:20; Needs Analysis:30; Value Proposition:40; Proposal/Price Quote:70; Closed Won:100; Closed Lost:0; all others:50. - deal_size_category: by amount with inclusive thresholds and strict positivity → ≥100000:Large; ≥25000:Medium; ≥5000:Small; >0:Micro; else:Unknown. NULL, 0, or negative amounts map to Unknown. - weighted_pipeline_value: treat NULL amount and probability as 0; compute (amount × probability) ÷ 100; floating-point result; no rounding. - win_probability_confidence: from probability (percent) → ≥75:High Confidence; ≥50:Medium Confidence; ≥25:Low Confidence; else:Very Low. NULL probability falls to Very Low. - opportunity_age_days: number of days from the date part of created_date to today; time-varying; NULL if created_date is NULL; can be negative if created_date is in the future. - deal_velocity_risk: based on opportunity_age_days → >180:High Risk; >90:Medium Risk; else:Low Risk. If age is NULL (created_date missing), result is Low Risk. - close_date_status: if close_date is before today:Overdue; if on or before 90 days from today:Current Quarter; else:On Track. NULL close_date is treated as On Track. - days_to_close: number of days from today to the date part of close_date; NULL if close_date is NULL; negative if in the past, 0 if today. - is_strategic_deal: true if amount ≥ 500000 or account_size_segment equals ''Enterprise''; else false. NULL inputs evaluate to false. - is_deleted output remains false due to the initial filter.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- User scope: include only users where is_active = true from staging.stg_salesforce__user. - Opportunity metrics: - Source: staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity filtered to records that are not deleted and have an owner_id. - Group by owner_id to compute: - total_opportunities: count of opportunities. - won_opportunities: count where the opportunity is marked won. - total_won_amount: sum of amount for won opportunities; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_pipeline_amount: sum of amount for open opportunities (not closed); NULL amounts do not contribute. - avg_won_deal_size: average amount across won opportunities; excludes NULL amounts. - Lead metrics: - Source: staging.stg_salesforce__lead filtered to records that are not deleted and have an owner_id. - Group by owner_id to compute: - total_leads: count of leads. - converted_leads: count where the lead is converted. - Assembly: - Left join both metric sets to the active user list on user_id = owner_id. - user_role_name is the constant value ''Sales''. - If a user has no matching opportunities or leads, all related numeric measures default to 0 (or 0.00 for decimals). - Rates: - win_rate_percentage: percentage of opportunities won out of total opportunities, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when there are no opportunities. - lead_conversion_rate_percentage: percentage of leads converted out of total leads, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when there are no leads. - activity_completion_rate_percentage: constant 0.0 (one decimal place). - Placeholders set to 0: lost_opportunities, open_opportunities, weighted_pipeline_amount, largest_won_deal, avg_sales_cycle_days, 30/90-day opportunity and lead counters, and all activity counts. - performance_tier: High Performer if won_opportunities ≥ 10; Good Performer if ≥ 5; Developing if total_opportunities > 0; otherwise New User. - is_active is taken from the user source and is always true for included rows.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: dim_salesforce__user
      description: Salesforce user dimension with role, manager, tenure, and performance metrics
      grain: One row per user_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user_role
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance
      business_logic: 'Build a user dimension from Salesforce user, role, and user performance data: - Start with all users from staging.stg_salesforce__user (u). - Left join staging.stg_salesforce__user_role (ur) on user_role_id to enrich role attributes. - Left self-join staging.stg_salesforce__user (manager) on u.manager_id = manager.user_id to derive manager fields. - Left join intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance (up) on user_id to append performance metrics. - full_name: concatenate first_name and last_name with a single space, treating NULL as empty string, then trim whitespace from both ends; if both names are NULL, return an empty string. - user_type: case-insensitive classification based on user_role_name (first match wins): • contains "sales" or "account" → "Sales" • contains "marketing" → "Marketing" • contains "manager" or "director" or "vp" → "Management" • contains "support" or "service" → "Customer Success" • contains "admin" → "Administrator" • otherwise (including NULL role name) → "Other" - user_tenure_days: if last_login_date is present, compute the number of days between last_login_date (date only) and today; otherwise NULL. - user_tenure_category: if last_login_date is NULL → "Unknown"; else bucket by days since last_login_date: <90 → "Recent User"; <365 → "Active User"; otherwise → "Experienced User". - manager_id and manager_name: manager_id is manager.user_id from the self-join; manager_name is built like full_name from the manager’s names; if no manager match, manager_id is NULL and manager_name is an empty string. - productivity_level: map performance_tier to: • "High Performer" → "High Productivity" • "Good Performer" → "Good Productivity" • "Developing" → "Developing Productivity" • "New User" → "New User" • otherwise (including NULL) → "Unknown" - system_adoption_level: based on up.total_activities and up.total_opportunities: • at least 100 activities and at least 20 opportunities → "High Adoption" • at least 50 activities and at least 10 opportunities → "Medium Adoption" • at least 10 activities and at least 5 opportunities → "Basic Adoption" • more than 0 activities OR more than 0 opportunities → "Limited Adoption" • otherwise (including NULL metrics) → "No Activity" - activities_per_win_ratio: if total_activities > 0 and won_opportunities > 0, compute total_activities divided by won_opportunities and round to 2 decimal places; otherwise NULL. - All metrics from the performance model are passed through without transformation and remain NULL if no matching performance record exists.'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique Salesforce user identifier; one output row per user_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce username
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User email address
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User first name
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User last name
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenation of first_name and last_name with a single space, trimming edges; NULL names treated as empty; both NULL → empty string
      - name: is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: User active flag
      - name: user_role_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Foreign key to the user's Salesforce role
      - name: user_role_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User role name from the role table; NULL if no matching role
      - name: role_developer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Developer (API) name of the user role
      - name: parent_role_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent role id in the role hierarchy
      - name: rollup_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Role roll-up description from the hierarchy
      - name: profile_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce profile id assigned to the user
      - name: user_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Role-based category from substring rules on user_role_name (Sales, Marketing, Management, Customer Success, Administrator, Other)
      - name: user_tenure_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from last_login_date to today; NULL if last_login_date is NULL
      - name: user_tenure_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tenure bucket: Unknown (no last_login_date), Recent (<90 days), Active (<365 days), Experienced (≥365 days)'
      - name: manager_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager's user_id from the self-join; NULL if no matching manager
      - name: manager_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenation of manager first_name and last_name, trimmed; empty string if no manager or both names are NULL
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Performance tier from the performance model; may be NULL
      - name: productivity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from performance_tier: High/Good/Developing Productivity, New User, or Unknown'
      - name: system_adoption_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from activity and opportunity thresholds in order: High, Medium, Basic, Limited, else No Activity'
      - name: total_opportunities
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total opportunities attributed to the user (pass-through)
      - name: won_opportunities
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total won opportunities attributed to the user (pass-through)
      - name: win_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opportunity win rate percentage (pass-through)
      - name: total_won_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won opportunity amounts (pass-through)
      - name: total_pipeline_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total pipeline amount (pass-through)
      - name: avg_won_deal_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average won deal size (pass-through)
      - name: total_leads
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total leads owned by the user (pass-through)
      - name: converted_leads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total converted leads (pass-through)
      - name: lead_conversion_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Lead conversion rate percentage (pass-through)
      - name: total_activities
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Total Salesforce activities completed or logged (pass-through)
      - name: activity_completion_rate_percentage
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Activity completion rate percentage (pass-through)
      - name: activities_per_win_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_activities > 0 and won_opportunities > 0, total_activities divided by won_opportunities rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: fct_salesforce__account_engagement
      description: Account-level engagement, risk, lifecycle, and health metrics joined from account attributes, activity summaries, and active owner user info
      grain: One row per account_id from intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced (account_id, account_name, account_type, account_size_segment, geographic_region, industry_normalized, annual_revenue, account_age_days, account_maturity_stage, is_high_value_account, data_completeness_score, owner_id, billing_country, billing_state, billing_city, website)
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__activity_summary (account_id, total_activities_30d, total_activities_90d, engagement_temperature, activity_frequency_score, days_since_last_activity, unique_activity_owners, activity_trend_30d, is_declining_engagement)
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user (user_id, first_name, last_name, is_active)
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced (ae), one row per account_id. - Left join intermediate.int_salesforce__activity_summary (acs) on ae.account_id = acs.account_id. - Build owner_name from staging.stg_salesforce__user filtered to is_active=true by concatenating first and last name with a space and trimming; if no active user matches, owner_name is NULL; if both names are missing, owner_name is an empty string. - Compute engagement_health_score (0–100) by summing component points: - Engagement temperature: Hot=30, Warm=20, Cool=10, Cold=5, else 0. - Activity frequency: High=25, Medium=15, Low=8, else 3. - Unique activity owners: >=3 ->20; >=2 ->12; >=1 ->5; else 0. - 30d activity trend: Increasing=15, Stable=8, New=5, else 0. - Data completeness: >=80 ->10; >=60 ->6; >=40 ->3; else 0. - If a component value is NULL, it falls to the else bucket (activity frequency adds 3; others add 0). - Compute churn_risk_indicator: - High if temperature in (''Cold'',''Dormant'') AND trend=''Decreasing'' AND 90d activities < 5 - Else Medium if temperature=''Cool'' AND 90d activities < 10 - Else Low if temperature=''Warm'' AND frequency=''Low'' - Else Minimal - NULL inputs do not match any rule and return Minimal. - Compute customer_lifecycle_stage (first match wins): - Onboarding if maturity=''New'' AND 30d activities >= 5 - Active Growth if maturity in (''Growing'',''Established'') AND temperature in (''Hot'',''Warm'') - Stable Relationship if maturity=''Mature'' AND temperature in (''Hot'',''Warm'') - At Risk if temperature=''Cool'' - Dormant if temperature in (''Cold'',''Dormant'') - Else Unknown - Compute relationship_depth from acs.unique_activity_owners: - >=5: Deep; >=3: Moderate; >=2: Basic; >=1: Single Point; else: No Engagement; NULL behaves as else. - Compute has_upsell_opportunity (boolean): true if is_high_value_account=true AND temperature in (''Hot'',''Warm'') AND frequency in (''High'',''Medium''); else false. - Compute account_health_status by bucketing the same total used for engagement_health_score: - >=80: Excellent; >=60: Good; >=40: Fair; else: Poor. - Output columns: - Pass through ae attributes and owner_id; owner_name comes only from active users. - Apply defaults to activity fields in the final projection: - total_activities_30d, total_activities_90d, unique_activity_owners -> 0 - engagement_temperature -> ''Dormant'' - activity_frequency_score -> ''Minimal'' - activity_trend_30d -> ''New'' - is_declining_engagement -> false - days_since_last_activity is not defaulted and may be NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key of the account; exactly one output row per account_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name passed through from ae without transformation
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce account type passed through from ae
      - name: account_size_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Size segment classification from ae
      - name: geographic_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Geographic region designation from ae
      - name: industry_normalized
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Normalized industry label from ae
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Annual revenue from ae; two decimal places; passed through without additional rounding or defaults
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Age of the account in days from ae; may be NULL if not provided
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account maturity stage from ae (e.g., New, Growing, Established, Mature)
      - name: is_high_value_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from ae indicating high-value accounts; used in upsell logic
      - name: data_completeness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–100 score from ae; if NULL it contributes 0 points in scoring
      - name: total_activities_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of activities in last 30 days; defaulted to 0 when NULL
      - name: total_activities_90d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of activities in last 90 days; defaulted to 0 when NULL
      - name: engagement_temperature
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Engagement temperature label; defaulted to 'Dormant' when NULL; referenced by scoring and risk/lifecycle rules
      - name: activity_frequency_score
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Frequency score label; defaulted to 'Minimal' when NULL; referenced by scoring and risk logic
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since most recent activity from acs; may be NULL if no activity exists
      - name: unique_activity_owners
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of activity owners; defaulted to 0 when NULL; scoring uses raw value where NULL contributes 0 points
      - name: activity_trend_30d
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 30-day activity trend label; defaulted to 'New' when NULL; used in scoring and risk logic
      - name: is_declining_engagement
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when engagement is declining per acs; defaulted to false when NULL
      - name: engagement_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Composite 0–100: temperature(30/20/10/5/0) + frequency(25/15/8/3) + owners(>=3:20,>=2:12,>=1:5,else 0) + trend(15/8/5/0) + data completeness(>=80:10,>=60:6,>=40:3,else 0); NULLs follow else (frequency adds 3; others add 0)'
      - name: churn_risk_indicator
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk bucket: High if cold/dormant AND decreasing AND 90d<5; else Medium if cool AND 90d<10; else Low if warm AND frequency=Low; else Minimal; NULLs fall through to Minimal'
      - name: customer_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle: Onboarding (New AND 30d>=5) > Active Growth (Growing/Established AND hot/warm) > Stable Relationship (Mature AND hot/warm) > At Risk (cool) > Dormant (cold/dormant) > Unknown; first matching rule applies'
      - name: relationship_depth
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Depth from unique_activity_owners: >=5 Deep, >=3 Moderate, >=2 Basic, >=1 Single Point, else No Engagement; NULL behaves as else'
      - name: has_upsell_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if is_high_value_account=true AND temperature in ('Hot','Warm') AND frequency in ('High','Medium'); else false
      - name: account_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucketed health using the same score as engagement_health_score: >=80 Excellent, >=60 Good, >=40 Fair, else Poor (inclusive thresholds)'
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user ID from ae; may not have a matching active user
      - name: owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active owner full name built by concatenating first and last name and trimming; NULL if no active match; empty string if both names are missing
      - name: billing_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing country from ae
      - name: billing_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing state from ae
      - name: billing_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing city from ae
      - name: website
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Website from ae; passed through without transformation

alternatives.expression_sql: CAST((CASE engagement_temperature WHEN 'Hot' THEN 30 WHEN 'Warm' THEN 20 WHEN 'Cool' THEN 10 WHEN 'Cold' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + CASE activity_frequency_score WHEN 'High' THEN 25 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 15 WHEN 'Low' THEN 8 ELSE 3 END + CASE WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 3 THEN 20 WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 2 THEN 12 WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 1 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + CASE activity_trend_30d WHEN 'Increasing' THEN 15 WHEN 'Stable' THEN 8 WHEN 'New' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN data_completeness_score >= 80 THEN 10 WHEN data_completeness_score >= 60 THEN 6 WHEN data_completeness_score >= 40 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS INT)

CASE WHEN engagement_temperature IN ('Cold', 'Dormant') AND activity_trend_30d = 'Decreasing' AND total_activities_90d < 5 THEN 'High' WHEN engagement_temperature = 'Cool' AND total_activities_90d < 10 THEN 'Medium' WHEN engagement_temperature = 'Warm' AND activity_frequency_score = 'Low' THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Minimal' END

CASE WHEN account_maturity_stage = 'New' AND total_activities_30d >= 5 THEN 'Onboarding' WHEN account_maturity_stage IN ('Growing', 'Established') AND engagement_temperature IN ('Hot', 'Warm') THEN 'Active Growth' WHEN account_maturity_stage = 'Mature' AND engagement_temperature IN ('Hot', 'Warm') THEN 'Stable Relationship' WHEN engagement_temperature = 'Cool' THEN 'At Risk' WHEN engagement_temperature IN ('Cold', 'Dormant') THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 5 THEN 'Deep' WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 3 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 2 THEN 'Basic' WHEN unique_activity_owners >= 1 THEN 'Single Point' ELSE 'No Engagement' END
(COALESCE(is_high_value_account, FALSE) AND engagement_temperature IN ('Hot', 'Warm') AND activity_frequency_score IN ('High', 'Medium'))
CASE WHEN engagement_health_score >= 80 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN engagement_health_score >= 60 THEN 'Good' WHEN engagement_health_score >= 40 THEN 'Fair' ELSE 'Poor' END

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced (ae), one row per account_id. - Left join intermediate.int_salesforce__activity_summary (acs) on ae.account_id = acs.account_id. - Build owner_name from staging.stg_salesforce__user filtered to is_active=true by concatenating first and last name with a space and trimming; if no active user matches, owner_name is NULL; if both names are missing, owner_name is an empty string. - Compute engagement_health_score (0–100) by summing component points: - Engagement temperature: Hot=30, Warm=20, Cool=10, Cold=5, else 0. - Activity frequency: High=25, Medium=15, Low=8, else 3. - Unique activity owners: >=3 ->20; >=2 ->12; >=1 ->5; else 0. - 30d activity trend: Increasing=15, Stable=8, New=5, else 0. - Data completeness: >=80 ->10; >=60 ->6; >=40 ->3; else 0. - If a component value is NULL, it falls to the else bucket (activity frequency adds 3; others add 0). - Compute churn_risk_indicator: - High if temperature in (''Cold'',''Dormant'') AND trend=''Decreasing'' AND 90d activities < 5 - Else Medium if temperature=''Cool'' AND 90d activities < 10 - Else Low if temperature=''Warm'' AND frequency=''Low'' - Else Minimal - NULL inputs do not match any rule and return Minimal. - Compute customer_lifecycle_stage (first match wins): - Onboarding if maturity=''New'' AND 30d activities >= 5 - Active Growth if maturity in (''Growing'',''Established'') AND temperature in (''Hot'',''Warm'') - Stable Relationship if maturity=''Mature'' AND temperature in (''Hot'',''Warm'') - At Risk if temperature=''Cool'' - Dormant if temperature in (''Cold'',''Dormant'') - Else Unknown - Compute relationship_depth from acs.unique_activity_owners: - >=5: Deep; >=3: Moderate; >=2: Basic; >=1: Single Point; else: No Engagement; NULL behaves as else. - Compute has_upsell_opportunity (boolean): true if is_high_value_account=true AND temperature in (''Hot'',''Warm'') AND frequency in (''High'',''Medium''); else false. - Compute account_health_status by bucketing the same total used for engagement_health_score: - >=80: Excellent; >=60: Good; >=40: Fair; else: Poor. - Output columns: - Pass through ae attributes and owner_id; owner_name comes only from active users. - Apply defaults to activity fields in the final projection: - total_activities_30d, total_activities_90d, unique_activity_owners -> 0 - engagement_temperature -> ''Dormant'' - activity_frequency_score -> ''Minimal'' - activity_trend_30d -> ''New'' - is_declining_engagement -> false - days_since_last_activity is not defaulted and may be NULL.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: fct_salesforce__lead_performance
      description: Lead conversion performance per lead with derived owner name, conversion flags, and created_date-based time attributes.
      grain: One row per lead_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel (lf); no filtering or aggregation; output grain is one row per lead_id. - Build an active user lookup from staging.stg_salesforce__user where is_active = true; compute owner_name by concatenating first_name and last_name with a single space, treating missing parts as empty, and trimming extra spaces. - Left join users to lf on lf.owner_id = user_id; if no active user matches, owner_name is NULL. - Derive conversion_rate as an integer flag: 1 when lf.is_converted is true, else 0. - Derive converted_to_opportunity as true when lf.converted_opportunity_id is present, else false. - Derive time attributes from lf.created_date: created_year (calendar year), created_quarter (1–4), created_month (1–12), created_week (ISO week 1–53). - Derive period flags relative to the current_date at runtime: - is_current_month is true when created_date falls in the current calendar month and year; otherwise false (also false if created_date is NULL). - is_current_quarter is true when created_date falls in the current calendar quarter and year; otherwise false (also false if created_date is NULL). - All other fields are passed through from lf unchanged.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique lead identifier; the result has one row per lead_id.
      - name: lead_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead display name from the funnel source.
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead first name from the funnel source.
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead last name from the funnel source.
      - name: company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead company name from the funnel source.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead email address from the funnel source.
      - name: lead_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Original lead source from the funnel source.
      - name: lead_source_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorized lead source from the funnel source.
      - name: lead_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Numeric quality score from the funnel source.
      - name: lead_temperature
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead temperature label from the funnel source.
      - name: is_converted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when the lead is marked converted in the funnel source; else false.
      - name: conversion_rate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Integer flag equal to 1 when is_converted is true, else 0; suitable for summing.
      - name: conversion_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days between creation and conversion as provided by the funnel source; NULL if not applicable.
      - name: conversion_speed_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bucketed conversion speed label from the funnel source.
      - name: has_complete_conversion
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when all funnel conversion steps are completed; else false.
      - name: converted_to_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when converted_opportunity_id is present; else false.
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead owner user_id from the funnel source used to join to active users.
      - name: owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner full name from active users built as 'first_name last_name' with extra spaces trimmed; NULL if no active user match.
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Lead creation timestamp from the funnel source used for time derivations.
      - name: created_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year derived from created_date.
      - name: created_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter (1–4) derived from created_date.
      - name: created_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month (1–12) derived from created_date.
      - name: created_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: ISO calendar week number (1–53) derived from created_date.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead status from the funnel source.
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead industry from the funnel source.
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Annual revenue amount from the funnel source; precision 18, scale 2.
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count from the funnel source.
      - name: converted_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the lead was converted; may be NULL.
      - name: converted_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID created by conversion, if any; NULL otherwise.
      - name: converted_contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact ID created by conversion, if any; NULL otherwise.
      - name: converted_opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity ID created by conversion, if any; NULL otherwise.
      - name: is_current_month
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when created_date falls in the current calendar month and year at runtime; else false or NULL treated as false.
      - name: is_current_quarter
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when created_date falls in the current calendar quarter and year at runtime; else false or NULL treated as false.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel (lf); no filtering or aggregation; output grain is one row per lead_id. - Build an active user lookup from staging.stg_salesforce__user where is_active = true; compute owner_name by concatenating first_name and last_name with a single space, treating missing parts as empty, and trimming extra spaces. - Left join users to lf on lf.owner_id = user_id; if no active user matches, owner_name is NULL. - Derive conversion_rate as an integer flag: 1 when lf.is_converted is true, else 0. - Derive converted_to_opportunity as true when lf.converted_opportunity_id is present, else false. - Derive time attributes from lf.created_date: created_year (calendar year), created_quarter (1–4), created_month (1–12), created_week (ISO week 1–53). - Derive period flags relative to the current_date at runtime: - is_current_month is true when created_date falls in the current calendar month and year; otherwise false (also false if created_date is NULL). - is_current_quarter is true when created_date falls in the current calendar quarter and year; otherwise false (also false if created_date is NULL). - All other fields are passed through from lf unchanged.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: fct_salesforce__sales_pipeline
      description: Sales pipeline fact joined with account and active owner details, enriched with date parts and derived health/status metrics
      grain: One row per opportunity_id from intermediate.int_salesforce__opportunity_pipeline; duplicates from source are preserved
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__opportunity_pipeline
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user
      business_logic: '- Build user_info from staging.stg_salesforce__user where is_active = true; set owner_name by concatenating first_name and last_name with a single space, treating missing names as empty, then trim leading/trailing spaces. - From intermediate.int_salesforce__opportunity_pipeline (op), left join intermediate.int_salesforce__account_enhanced (ae) on account_id, and left join user_info (ui) on owner_id. - Derive close_year, close_quarter, close_month as the calendar year, quarter, and month of close_date; these are NULL when close_date is NULL. - Derive created_year, created_quarter, created_month as the calendar year, quarter, and month of created_date; these are NULL when created_date is NULL. - pipeline_health_score: Healthy when stage_progression_score ≥ 70, probability ≥ 50, and deal_velocity_risk is New or Low Risk; Moderate when stage_progression_score ≥ 50 and probability ≥ 25; At Risk when stage_progression_score ≥ 30; otherwise Poor. - forecast_accuracy_days: for closed opportunities with close_date on or before today, return the non-negative number of days between close_date and today; otherwise NULL. - is_current_quarter_close: true when close_date falls in the same calendar quarter and year as today; false otherwise (including NULL close_date). - is_current_quarter_created: true when created_date falls in the same calendar quarter and year as today; false otherwise (including NULL created_date). - opportunity_status: Won if is_won; Lost if is_closed and not is_won; Open if not is_closed; otherwise Unknown. - deal_cycle_category: Quick (≤30 days), Standard (31–90 days), Extended (91–180 days), or Long Cycle (>180 days) based on opportunity_age_days; thresholds are inclusive. - Output all selected columns; fields from non-matching joins are NULL; no additional filtering or de-duplication.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: salesforce__account_daily_history
      description: Daily snapshots of Salesforce account history capturing, per account and day, the most recent non-deleted change.
      grain: One row per account_id per snapshot_date (latest non-deleted change on that day)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account_history
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__account_history. - Keep only rows where is_deleted is FALSE; rows with is_deleted TRUE or NULL are excluded. - Derive snapshot_date by taking the calendar date from created_date (time removed). - For each (account_id, snapshot_date), sort records by created_date descending and select the first (latest) record for that day. - If multiple records share the exact same created_date timestamp within a day, no secondary tiebreaker is applied; any one of the tied rows may be chosen. - Output the listed fields directly from the chosen record; no transformations beyond deriving snapshot_date. - NULL values in selected fields are preserved; no standardization or unit changes. - Only days with at least one non-deleted record produce a row; no date backfilling. - Final output is ordered by account_id ascending, then snapshot_date ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce account identifier for the snapshot.
      - name: snapshot_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date derived from created_date used to group daily changes.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: account_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account source on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Industry on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Annual revenue on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner ID on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: billing_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing city on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: billing_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing state on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: billing_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Billing country on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: website
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Website on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Rating on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: ownership
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ownership on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: parent_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account ID on the selected latest change for that day.
      - name: last_activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Last activity date on the selected latest change for that day.

- name: salesforce__contact_daily_history
      description: Daily snapshots of Salesforce contacts, selecting the latest non-deleted change per contact per calendar day
      grain: One row per contact_id per snapshot_date
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__contact_history
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__contact_history. - Keep only records where is_deleted is false; records with is_deleted true or NULL are excluded. - Derive snapshot_date as the calendar date of created_date (time dropped). - For each contact_id and snapshot_date, sort records by created_date descending and select the first record; if multiple records share the exact same created_date timestamp, which record is chosen among them is undefined. - Output the selected fields without transformation; NULLs, casing, and whitespace are preserved. - Order the final result by contact_id ascending, then snapshot_date ascending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: salesforce__daily_activity
      description: Daily summary by date_day of leads created/converted, tasks/events counts, and opportunity creation/closure metrics with amounts rounded to 0 decimals.
      grain: One row per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      - staging.stg_salesforce__task
      - staging.stg_salesforce__event
      - staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__date_spine
      business_logic: '- Start from the date spine (one row per date_day); this drives the output. - Tasks: group tasks by the calendar day of activity_date; tasks_completed is the number of non-null task records on that day; tasks with a null activity_date do not contribute and will not join; no additional filters. - Events: define each event’s activity day as the calendar day of activity_date, otherwise the calendar day of activity_date_time; if both are null the event is excluded; events_completed is the number of non-null event records on that day. - Leads created: group leads by the calendar day of created_date; leads_created is the number of non-null lead records on that day; rows with a null created_date are excluded. - Leads converted: restrict to leads where is_converted is true; group by the calendar day of converted_date; leads_converted is the number of non-null lead records on that day; rows with a null converted_date are excluded. - Opportunities base: for each opportunity derive created_day from created_date and close_day from close_date; set status as: • Won when is_won is true • Lost when is_won is false and is_closed is true • Pipeline when not closed and forecast_category (case-insensitive) is one of pipeline, forecast, bestcase • Other otherwise Amount may be null and is used in sums. - Opportunities created (by created_day): • opportunities_created: number of non-null opportunity records • opportunities_created_amount: sum of amount rounded to 0 decimals; sums ignore null amounts and are null when all amounts are null - Opportunities closed (by close_day): • opportunities_won: number of opportunities with status Won; zero when there are close_day records but none Won; null when no close_day records • opportunities_won_amount: sum of amounts for status Won rounded to 0 decimals; zero when there are close_day records but none Won; null when no close_day records • opportunities_lost: number of opportunities with status Lost; zero when there are close_day records but none Lost; null when no close_day records • opportunities_lost_amount: sum of amounts for status Lost rounded to 0 decimals; null when there are close_day records but none Lost; null when no close_day records • pipeline_amount: sum of amounts for status Pipeline rounded to 0 decimals; null when there are close_day records but none Pipeline; null when no close_day records - Output: left join each aggregate to the date spine on date_day; if a date has no matching aggregate row, the corresponding fields remain null; no defaulting to zero beyond the rules above.'

        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: leads_created
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of leads created on date_day based on created_date; only non-null lead records counted; null when no leads match that day.
      - name: leads_converted

        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)

      - name: opportunities_lost
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Lost; zero when close_date records exist but none Lost; null when no close_date records.
      - name: opportunities_lost_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)

      - name: pipeline_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of amounts for opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Pipeline, rounded to 0 decimals; null when close_date records exist but none Pipeline or when no close_date records.

blocks.original_text:
- name: salesforce__manager_performance
      description: Manager-level aggregation of team performance metrics joined with manager profile and derived ratios
      grain: One row per manager_id
      source_models:
      - marts.salesforce__owner_performance
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user
      business_logic: '- Start from marts.salesforce__owner_performance and keep rows with a non-null manager_id. - Aggregate by manager_id: - total_team_members is the count of distinct owner_id values (nulls excluded). - For all team amounts and counts listed in the columns (excluding averages and maxima), sum the corresponding owner-level values after replacing nulls with 0; if all inputs are null, the result is 0. - team_avg_days_to_close is the simple average of owner-level avg_days_to_close after replacing nulls with 0; unweighted by deal counts; no rounding applied. - team_largest_booking and team_largest_pipeline_deal are the maximum owner-level values after treating nulls as 0; if all inputs are null, the result is 0. - Enrich with manager profile by left joining staging.stg_salesforce__user on user_id = manager_id; unmatched profile fields remain null. - Derive ratios: - win_loss_ratio is team_total_bookings_amount divided by team_total_lost_amount, rounded to 2 decimals, only when both amounts are greater than 0; otherwise null. - avg_bookings_per_rep is team_total_bookings_amount divided by total_team_members, rounded to 2 decimals, only when total_team_members is greater than 0; otherwise 0. - Output one row per manager_id; the final result is ordered by team_total_bookings_amount descending (ordering does not change values).'
      columns:
      - name: manager_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager identifier; grouping key for all metrics
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: total_team_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of owner_id under the manager; null owner_id excluded; duplicates collapsed
      - name: team_bookings_amount_this_month
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of bookings_amount_closed_this_month across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_bookings_amount_this_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of bookings_amount_closed_this_quarter across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_total_bookings
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total_number_bookings across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_total_bookings_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of total_bookings_amount across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_lost_amount_this_month
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of lost_amount_this_month across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_lost_amount_this_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of lost_amount_this_quarter across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_total_lost
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total_number_lost across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_total_lost_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of total_lost_amount across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_pipeline_created_this_month
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of pipeline_created_amount_this_month across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_pipeline_created_this_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of pipeline_created_amount_this_quarter across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_total_pipeline
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total_number_pipeline across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_total_pipeline_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of total_pipeline_amount across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0
      - name: team_avg_days_to_close
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Simple average of avg_days_to_close across owners with nulls treated as 0; unweighted; no rounding
      - name: team_largest_booking
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Maximum largest_booking across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0; if all nulls then 0.00
      - name: team_largest_pipeline_deal
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Maximum largest_deal_in_pipeline across the manager’s owners with nulls treated as 0; if all nulls then 0.00
      - name: manager_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager full name from stg_salesforce__user.user_name; null if no user match
      - name: manager_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager email from stg_salesforce__user.email; null if no user match
      - name: manager_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager title from stg_salesforce__user.title; null if no user match
      - name: manager_department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager department from stg_salesforce__user.department; null if no user match
      - name: manager_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager city from stg_salesforce__user.city; null if no user match
      - name: manager_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Manager state from stg_salesforce__user.state; null if no user match
      - name: win_loss_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: team_total_bookings_amount ÷ team_total_lost_amount, rounded to 2 decimals, only when both > 0; else null
      - name: avg_bookings_per_rep
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: team_total_bookings_amount ÷ total_team_members, rounded to 2 decimals, only when total_team_members > 0; else 0
